```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

```{r Load Packages}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(ineq)
library(emmeans)
library(multcomp)
library(tidyr)
library(readxl)
library(DHARMa)
```

```{r Load data}
CanopyCover <- read_excel("FDiv_PlantedTreeData_final_excel.xlsx", sheet = "CanopyCover")
CanopyCover$Treatment <- factor(CanopyCover$Treatment, levels = c("C", "M1", "M2", "2sp", "6sp", "12sp"))
```

```{r Summarize year 3}
CanopyCover3 <- CanopyCover %>% filter(Year == "3")

CanopyCover_summary <- CanopyCover3 %>%
  group_by(Site, Treatment, `Plot identification`) %>%
  summarise(
    Plot_Canopy_Cover = mean(Percent_canopy_cover, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Canopy_Cover = sd(Percent_canopy_cover, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

CanopyCover_summary_avg <- CanopyCover_summary %>%
  group_by(Site, Treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_canopy = mean(Plot_Canopy_Cover, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_canopy = sd(Plot_Canopy_Cover, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r Model canopy cover year 3}
# Site as fixed effect (4 levels), block (Plot identification) nested within Site as random
canopy_model <- lmer(
  Plot_Canopy_Cover ~ Treatment * Site + (1 | Site:`Plot identification`),
  data = CanopyCover_summary
)

summary(canopy_model)
anova(canopy_model)

simulationOutput <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = canopy_model, plot = TRUE)
testDispersion(simulationOutput)
testZeroInflation(simulationOutput)

# Pairwise comparisons by site
means_canopy <- emmeans(canopy_model, pairwise ~ Treatment | Site, type = "response")
cld_sign_canopy <- as.data.frame(cld(means_canopy$emmeans, Letters = letters, adjust = "tukey", alpha = 0.05, decreasing = TRUE))

# Pooled pairwise comparisons
means_canopy_pooled <- emmeans(canopy_model, pairwise ~ Treatment, type = "response")
cld_sign_canopy_pooled <- as.data.frame(cld(means_canopy_pooled$emmeans, Letters = letters, adjust = "tukey", alpha = 0.05, decreasing = TRUE))
```

```{r Plot canopy cover year 3 — by site}
canopybar <- ggplot(CanopyCover_summary_avg, aes(x = Treatment, y = mean_canopy, fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_jitter(data = CanopyCover_summary,
              aes(x = Treatment, y = Plot_Canopy_Cover),
              width = 0.2, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.5, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(mean_canopy - sd_canopy, 0),
                    ymax = mean_canopy + sd_canopy),
                width = 0.2, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(data = cld_sign_canopy, family = "sans", show.legend = FALSE,
            check_overlap = FALSE, size = 3, vjust = 1,
            aes(x = Treatment, y = Inf, label = .group)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("12sp" = "darkblue", "2sp" = "deepskyblue",
                               "6sp" = "deepskyblue4", "M1" = "firebrick",
                               "M2" = "coral"), guide = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~ Site) +
  labs(x = "Treatment", y = "Mean Canopy Cover (%)") +
  theme_classic()

ggsave("canopy_barplot_year_3.jpeg", plot = canopybar, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r Gini canopy cover — model and plot}
gini_canopy_cover <- CanopyCover3 %>%
  group_by(Site, Treatment, `Plot identification`) %>%
  summarize(Gini_Canopy = ineq(Percent_canopy_cover, type = "Gini"), .groups = "drop")

gini_canopy_summary <- gini_canopy_cover %>%
  group_by(Site, Treatment) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_gini = mean(Gini_Canopy, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_gini = sd(Gini_Canopy, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

gini_model_canopy <- lmer(
  Gini_Canopy ~ Treatment * Site + (1 | Site:`Plot identification`),
  data = gini_canopy_cover
)

summary(gini_model_canopy)
anova(gini_model_canopy)

simulationOutput <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = gini_model_canopy, plot = TRUE)
testDispersion(simulationOutput)
testZeroInflation(simulationOutput)

means_gini <- emmeans(gini_model_canopy, pairwise ~ Treatment | Site, type = "response")
cld_sign_gini <- as.data.frame(cld(means_gini$emmeans, Letters = letters, adjust = "tukey", alpha = 0.05, decreasing = TRUE))

ginicanopybar <- ggplot(gini_canopy_summary, aes(x = Treatment, y = mean_gini, fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_jitter(data = gini_canopy_cover,
              aes(x = Treatment, y = Gini_Canopy),
              width = 0.2, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.5, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(mean_gini - sd_gini, 0),
                    ymax = mean_gini + sd_gini),
                width = 0.2, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(data = cld_sign_gini, family = "sans", show.legend = FALSE,
            check_overlap = FALSE, size = 3, vjust = 1,
            aes(x = Treatment, y = Inf, label = .group)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("12sp" = "darkblue", "2sp" = "deepskyblue",
                               "6sp" = "deepskyblue4", "M1" = "firebrick",
                               "M2" = "coral"), guide = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~ Site) +
  labs(x = "Treatment", y = "Mean Gini Coefficient of Canopy Cover") +
  theme_classic()

ggsave("ginicanopyyear3.jpeg", plot = ginicanopybar, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 800)
```

```{r Time series — canopy cover}
CanopyCover_LLFS <- CanopyCover %>%
  filter(Site == "LLFS") %>%
  mutate(Year = as.character(Year),
         Year = ifelse(Year == "2023", "Year 2", Year),
         Year = ifelse(Year == "2024", "Year 3", Year))

CanopyCover_other_sites <- CanopyCover %>%
  filter(Site != "LLFS") %>%
  mutate(Year = as.character(Year),
         Year = ifelse(Year == "2023", "Year 1", Year),
         Year = ifelse(Year == "2024", "Year 2", Year),
         Year = ifelse(Year == "2025", "Year 3", Year))

CanopyCover_time <- bind_rows(CanopyCover_LLFS, CanopyCover_other_sites) %>%
  mutate(Year = factor(Year, levels = c("Year 1", "Year 2", "Year 3")))

CanopyCover_time_summary <- CanopyCover_time %>%
  group_by(Site, Treatment, `Plot identification`, Year) %>%
  summarise(
    Plot_Canopy_Cover = mean(Percent_canopy_cover, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

canopy_time_model <- lmer(
  Plot_Canopy_Cover ~ Treatment * Site * Year + (1 | Site:`Plot identification`),
  data = CanopyCover_time_summary
)
anova(canopy_time_model)

canopy_summary_time <- CanopyCover_time_summary %>%
  group_by(Site, Treatment, Year) %>%
  summarize(
    Plot_Canopy_Cover = mean(Plot_Canopy_Cover, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Canopy_Cover = sd(Plot_Canopy_Cover, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

treatment_colors <- c("12sp" = "darkblue", "2sp" = "deepskyblue",
                       "6sp" = "deepskyblue4", "M1" = "firebrick",
                       "M2" = "coral", "C" = "darkgrey")

treatment_labels <- c("12sp" = "12-species plots", "2sp" = "2-species plots",
                       "6sp" = "6-species plots", "M1" = "N-fixer monocultures (1)",
                       "M2" = "Fleshy fruit monocultures (2)", "C" = "Control")

for (site in c("FAB", "FCEA", "LLFS")) {
  yr_filter <- if (site == "LLFS") NULL else "Year 1"
  d <- canopy_summary_time %>% filter(Site == site)
  if (!is.null(yr_filter)) d <- d %>% filter(Year != yr_filter)

  show_legend <- site == "LLFS"
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = Year, y = Plot_Canopy_Cover, group = Treatment, color = Treatment)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_point(size = 5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = treatment_colors, labels = treatment_labels) +
    ylim(0, 100) +
    labs(x = "Years after Planting", y = "Mean Canopy Cover (%)", color = "Treatment") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 11), axis.title = element_text(size = 12))

  if (!show_legend) p <- p + theme(legend.position = "none")
  w <- if (show_legend) 6 else 4
  ggsave(paste0("canopy_", site, ".jpeg"), plot = p, width = w, height = 5, dpi = 300)
}
```
